s: The Draft National Energy Policy of 2017 was prepared by which body?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
x: The Draft National Energy Policy (2017) was prepared by NITI Aayog, which had earlier also produced the India Energy Security Scenarios 2047.
tq: NITI Aayog drafts the 'Energy' policy; Ministry of Power issues the 'Electricity' policy.

s: The National Electricity Policy, 2005 was issued by
x: The National Electricity Policy 2005 was issued by the Ministry of Power, as required under the Electricity Act 2003. Its replacement, the Draft National Electricity Policy 2026, also comes from the Ministry of Power.
tq: Electricity policy = Ministry of Power (2005 and 2026).

s:
The Draft National Electricity Policy 2026 covers which of the following?
1. Hybrid renewable energy
2. Battery energy storage systems (BESS)
3. Smart grids
4. Time-of-Day tariffs
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
x: All four are correct: the Draft National Electricity Policy 2026 of the Ministry of Power covers hybrid RE, BESS, smart grids and Time-of-Day tariffs.
tq: Draft NEP 2026 = 'H-B-S-T': Hybrid, BESS, Smart grids, ToD.

s: Which one of the following is NOT an operational intervention under UDAY?
x: Distribution of energy-efficient LED bulbs (UJALA) is a demand-side intervention under UDAY. Feeder/DT metering, AT&C loss reduction and coal swapping are operational interventions.
tq: Operational = fix the DISCOM's own network and costs; demand-side = make consumers use less.

s: The Rayalaseema Thermal Power Plant at Muddanur (Kadapa) has an installed capacity of about
x: Rayalaseema TPP at Muddanur in Kadapa district has a capacity of 1,650 MW. 2,560 MW is Dr NTTPS, 1,600 MW is Krishnapatnam Stage I and 3,200 MW is each proposed ultra mega plant.

s: Stage I of the Sri Damodaram Sanjeevaiah Thermal Power Station (SDSTPS) at Krishnapatnam, Nellore, consists of
x: Stage I of SDSTPS at Krishnapatnam (Nellore) consists of two 800 MW units (2x800 MW). A single 800 MW unit was Stage V of Dr NTTPS commissioned in December 2023.

s: The APERC-approved resource plan (2024-25) provides for how much additional generation capacity in Andhra Pradesh over five years?
x: The resource plan approved by APERC in 2024-25 provides for 11,544 MW of additional capacity over five years.

s: In the context of nuclear applications in agriculture, the number of crop varieties developed using Trombay (BARC) technology is
x: 72 crop varieties have been developed by Trombay (BARC), a non-power use of nuclear technology that supports food security.

s: In Andhra Pradesh, Sustainable Development Goal targets have been built into which vision document?
x: SDG targets have been built into Swarna Andhra @2047, Andhra Pradesh's long-term vision.
tq: Swarna Andhra 2047 carries the SDGs to the centenary.

s: A May 2026 survey of dragonflies and damselflies in the Western Ghats found approximately what share of historically recorded species?
x: The survey found only about 65% of historically recorded species, recording 143 species (40 endemic) across 144 sites in five States.

s: Which one of the following is the largest negotiating group of developing countries in the UNFCCC process?
x: The G77 and China is the main and largest developing-country group. LMDC is a smaller hard-line group on equity and CBDR, BASIC has four members, and AOSIS is limited to small island states.

s: Which negotiating bloc in climate talks, made up of small island states, is known for pressing for the 1.5°C temperature goal?
x: AOSIS (Alliance of Small Island States) presses for the 1.5°C goal, as its members face existential threats from sea-level rise.

s: As of July 2026, the amount allotted to Andhra Pradesh under SDMF/NDMF (State/National Disaster Mitigation Fund) was
x: Andhra Pradesh was allotted Rs 521.17 crore under SDMF/NDMF. Rs 479.01 crore and Rs 277.63 crore were SDRF/NDRF releases in 2026-27 and 2025-26.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026:
1. They make biomining/bioremediation of legacy dumps mandatory.
2. 'Lakshya Zero Dumpsites' is linked to the drive to clear legacy dumpsites.
3. They prohibit the use of microbes for waste clean-up.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: SWM Rules 2026 mandate biomining/bioremediation of legacy dumps, alongside 'Lakshya Zero Dumpsites'. Statement 3 is false, since bioremediation itself uses microbes.
tq: SWM 2026: legacy dumps must be biomined - target zero dumpsites.

s: Component A of PM-KUSUM relates to
o: Installation of standalone off-grid solar pumps
Solarisation of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps
Decentralised grid-connected solar/renewable power plants on barren or fallow land
x: Component A of PM-KUSUM covers decentralised grid-connected solar/renewable plants on barren or fallow land. Standalone pumps and solarisation of grid-connected pumps are the other components.

s: As of 30 August 2026, Andhra Pradesh reported how many malaria cases, marking a rise of 27.9%?
x: AP reported 7,895 malaria cases up to 30 August 2026, a 27.9% rise, concentrated in tribal districts such as ASR, Polavaram and Vizianagaram. 7,119 and 7,871 are the full-year 2025 and 2024 figures; 1,475 is the 2026 dengue count.

s: As per the September 2026 update for Andhra Pradesh, which pairing of 2026 case counts is correct?
x: In 2026 (to 30 Aug) AP reported 1,475 dengue cases (+4.6%) and 941 scrub typhus cases. 2,686 and 5,555 were dengue totals for 2025 and 2024.

s: As of July 2026, cancer had been made a notifiable disease in how many States?
x: As of 4 July 2026, cancer was notifiable in 17 States, a step towards better NCD surveillance.

s: Which of the following is correctly matched with Andhra Pradesh's NCD-care initiatives?
x: Vizianagaram hosts the diabetic-foot clinic. Palasa has the kidney centre, and Uddanam (including Kaviti) is known for CKDu.

s:
Which of the following were part of Andhra Pradesh's response during the COVID-19 pandemic?
1. Volunteer-led fever surveys
2. Coverage under Aarogyasri
3. The Covid Pharma app
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
x: All three are correct: Andhra Pradesh used volunteer fever surveys, Aarogyasri coverage for COVID treatment and the Covid Pharma app.
tq: AP COVID trio: Volunteers, Aarogyasri, Pharma app.

s: After the 2024 change of government in Andhra Pradesh, YSR Rythu Bharosa was renamed
x: YSR Rythu Bharosa was renamed Annadata Sukhibhava. Talliki Vandanam replaced Amma Vodi, NTR Bharosa replaced YSR Pension Kanuka, and Rythu Seva Kendras replaced Rythu Bharosa Kendras.
